name: Eye Behind Your Back
description: Who needs peripheral vision when one eye is doing all the work?
tips: Eat Lazory with Power Pellet while his laser is active.

name: Oh, You're Approaching Me?
description: You really chose to walk toward the laser.
tips: Eat Lazory with Metal Power while he is beaming his laser directly at you.

name: Laser Tag
description: Finally, a laser tag match where someone actually gets vaporized.
tips: Kill Lazory with Laser Power while his laser is active.

name: Eradicated
description: That laser was, apparently, very effective.
tips: Get killed by Lazory's laser.

name: Negative Aura
description: Your points have entered the negatives. Truly impressive.
tips: Let Magneto run free until your points reach -5,000.

name: Escape Gravity
description: Sometimes the best way to beat gravity is simply to walk away.
tips: Have Magneto charge at you while in Metal Form, then dodge him instead of eating him.

name: Tax Evasion
description: Magneto has been audited.
tips: Kill Magneto after he has stolen at least 2 Power Pellets.

name: A Small Price to Pay
description: It was only half the pellets. Surely that won't matter.
tips: Let Magneto eat 50% of the maze's pellets and proceed to the next level.

name: Loan Shark
description: At 90%, this is less of a loan and more of a hostile acquisition.
tips: Let Magneto eat 90% of the maze's pellets and proceed to the next level.

name: Woodchipper
description: Three powers enter. The maze leaves in pieces.
tips: Have Clones, Speed, and Magnet Power active at the same time.

name: GGEZ
description: The maze never stood a chance.
tips: Clear the entire board in under 1 minute.

name: Nitpicker
description: You found the point and removed it.
tips: Kill Cacty with Spike Power.

name: Point Taken
description: You tried to eat a cactus. What did you expect?
tips: Get killed while trying to eat Cacty with Power Pellet.

name: He Can Do That??
description: Apparently, yes. He can do that.
tips: Get killed by Cacty's projectile spike.

name: It Pops Out of Nowhere
description: The spikes were there. You just weren't looking.
tips: Get killed by a spike spawned by Cacty.

name: Surprise!
description: Nothing says welcome like a ghost spawning directly beside you.
tips: Get killed by a newly spawned ghost near the portal.

name: Hot Wheel
description: Zoomie met the wrong kind of hot wheels.
tips: Kill Zoomie with Fire Trail while he is charging at you.

name: Ghost Rider
description: Gotta go fast. Gotta go hot.
tips: Have Speed and Fire Power active at the same time.

name: Cold Drift
description: Even Zoomie can't outrun absolute cold.
tips: Freeze Zoomie while he is in his dash state.

name: Headbutt
description: When two idiots charge at each other, Pac-Man wins.
tips: Run toward Zoomie as he charges at you and eat him.

name: Your Too Slow
description: You were, in fact, too slow.
tips: Get chased down and killed by Zoomie.

name: You’ve Fallen Into My Trap
description: You have activated the trap card, Zoomie!
tips: Run away from Zoomie as he charges at you while having Power Pellet, causing him to die as soon as he touches you.

name: Family of 4
description: A perfectly normal family outing. For everyone except the ghosts.
tips: Kill Bobby and the three ghosts she spawns.

name: Where Are These Coming From??
description: Bobby appears to have discovered infinite friends.
tips: Let Bobby spawn at least 10 ghosts onto the board.

name: You're Evil, Man
description: You left Bobby alive. That somehow makes this worse.
tips: Kill at least 10 ghosts spawned by Bobby without killing Bobby, then proceed to the next level.

name: The Chance Is Rigged
description: Ten Clonies. Zero freebies. Suspicious.
tips: Kill 10 Clonies in a row without them dropping any Power.

name: The Ghoulonies
description: There are now more Clonies than anyone reasonably needs.
tips: Let the number of Clonies on the board reach 20 or more.

name: You and What Armies?
description: Apparently, nine clones.
tips: Have 9 Pac-Clones active on the board.

name: Clone War
description: The clones have begun fighting among themselves.
tips: Kill a Clony with a Pac-Clone.

name: Aw Man
description: Well, that went with a bang.
tips: Get blown up by Bomby.

name: Explosive Flavor
description: Turns out Bomby is not food.
tips: Get killed while trying to eat Bomby with Power Pellet.

name: Defused
description: No boom today.
tips: Freeze Bomby before he can explode.

name: Terrorizer
description: Five ghosts, one very explosive solution.
tips: Kill 5 ghosts with Bomb Power.

name: Get Nuked
description: Ten ghosts. That is no longer a bomb. That is a statement.
tips: Kill 10 ghosts with Bomb Power.

name: Charged Explosion
description: Electricity makes everything more exciting.
tips: Electrocute Bomby or GH-05T.

name: OMG, GET AWAY FROM ME
description: Running away only made Bomby faster. Oops.
tips: Let Bomby reach maximum speed and kill you with his explosion.

name: Detonate from a Safe Distance
description: Safety first. Explosion second.
tips: Kill Bomby with any ranged Power.

name: Accidental Ally
description: Bomby helped. Bomby did not mean to help.
tips: Make Bomby explode and kill 5 nearby ghosts.

name: Go Out with a Bang
description: You got the kill. Bomby got the last laugh.
tips: Kill Bomby with Bomb Power and die to his explosion.

name: Mine Is Bigger
description: Bigger explosion wins. Somehow, you survived.
tips: Kill Bomby with Bomb Power without dying.

name: Fire Ball
description: Fire plus bomb. What could possibly go wrong?
tips: Activate Bomb Power while Fire Power is active and kill a ghost with it.

name: Absolute Zero
description: Bombs are apparently compatible with winter.
tips: Activate Bomb Power while Ice Power is active and kill a ghost with it.

name: Kill Fire with Fire
description: The best way to fight fire is apparently more fire.
tips: Kill Infernous with Fire Power.

name: Toasted
description: You have been thoroughly cooked.
tips: Get burned by Infernous's fire.

name: Oh No, He’s Hot
description: That was a very short-lived victory.
tips: Get killed by Infernous's fire within 0.5 seconds of eating him.

name: Medium Rare
description: Perfectly cooked. Not even slightly burned.
tips: Eat Infernous without getting burned.

name: Fire Extinguisher
description: Ice: 1. Fire: 0.
tips: Kill Infernous with Ice Power.

name: Hotter Than the Sun
description: Apparently the sun isn't the hottest thing in the maze.
tips: Kill Infernous with Laser Power.

name: Colder Than Ice
description: Icy has been introduced to an even worse day.
tips: Freeze Icy.

name: Slippery Slope
description: Ice is slippery. Ghosts are deadly. You did the math.
tips: Get killed by any ghost while sliding on ice.

name: Clearly, Skill Issue
description: The ice was not the problem. Probably.
tips: Get killed by Icy while sliding on ice.

name: Oh God, I Can’t Move
description: And now you understand Icy's plan.
tips: Get frozen by Icy.

name: Brainfreeze
description: The name was not metaphorical.
tips: Eat Icy and experience the speed debuff.

name: Ice Breaker
description: A hundred cubes later, you are still not done.
tips: Break 100 ice cubes.

name: Get Squished
description: The cube was pushed. The ghost was there. Physics happened.
tips: Push an ice cube into a ghost.

name: Unstoppable Force
description: One cube. Three ghosts. Very poor decision-making.
tips: Kill more than 2 ghosts with a single ice cube.

name: Immovable Object
description: The cube won.
tips: Get killed by an ice cube pushed into you.

name: Betrayal
description: You expected help from your clone. Foolish.
tips: Get killed by an ice cube pushed into you by a Pac-Clone.

name: Ice Hockey
description: Puck, ghost, same difference.
tips: Push an ice cube into Icy.

name: Decorative Ice Rink
description: It is technically a rink now.
tips: Have 10 ice cubes on the board.

name: Skating Rink
description: Half the maze is now a skating hazard.
tips: Cover half of the maze in ice.

name: Achieve Icy’s Dream
description: The maze has become one giant freezer.
tips: Convert the entire maze into ice. Walls don't count.

name: Winter Is Over
description: Spring cleaning, Pac-Man edition.
tips: Melt 100 ice tiles.

name: Oh Yeah, Right
description: Fire and ice. Surely this won't cause problems.
tips: Collect Fire Power while Ice Power is active, or vice versa.

name: This Is Bullshit
description: Fire and water. That makes even less sense.
tips: Collect Fire Power while Water Power is active, or vice versa.

name: I Can Skate!
description: Metal Pac-Man has discovered ice physics.
tips: Move on ice while using Metal Power.

name: Who Designed This Thing?
description: Someone apparently forgot that metal and water don't mix.
tips: Get killed by walking into water while using Metal Power.

name: Hi, How Are You?
description: A perfectly normal greeting between two pieces of metal.
tips: Slam into GH-05T while using Metal Power.

name: Target Eliminated
description: Target successfully eliminated. At what cost?
tips: Get killed by GH-05T.

name: Self-Destruct in 3...
description: Three seconds? Who needs three seconds?
tips: Detonate GH-05T with Magnet Power.

name: I Have the High Ground
description: The high ground was apparently made of water.
tips: Kill GH-05T by leading it into water tiles you created.

name: IT’S NOT WORKING
description: Sometimes the laser really does just not work.
tips: Try to shoot a laser at GH-05T for 1 second.

name: Maze Surfer
description: No board required.
tips: Walk across 100 water tiles.

name: Flooded
description: Congratulations. You've ruined the floor.
tips: Cover 50% of the maze with water.

name: Wavey’s Aquarium
description: At least the fish are happy.
tips: Cover the entire maze with water tiles. Walls don't count.

name: Live Wire
description: Water and electricity: a classic combination for bad decisions.
tips: Conduct a water tile.

name: Winter Is Coming
description: The water is having a very cold day.
tips: Freeze 100 water tiles.

name: Too Cold for Summer
description: Wavey has seen the last of summer.
tips: Freeze Wavey.

name: I’m Icy!
description: You are now your own weather system.
tips: Have Water Power and Ice Power active at the same time.

name: Antarctica
description: Chain reaction, but make it freezing.
tips: Get frozen by chain-freezing water.

name: Heart Attack
description: You touched the wrong water.
tips: Get electrocuted by Flashy.

name: Don’t Tread on Me
description: That water was charged, you stupid mutt.
tips: Walk into conducted water tiles.

name: I Choose You, P*kachu
description: Gotta zap them all.
tips: Use Electric Power while Pac-Clones are active.

name: Fast Charger
description: Flashy got a shocking surprise.
tips: Electrocute Flashy.

name: Walking Tempest
description: All that electricity, absolutely no productivity.
tips: Waste all of your Electric Power without killing a single ghost.

name: Rocks Are Uninterested in Weather
description: Boulder remains unimpressed by your fancy weather powers.
tips: Try to electrocute, freeze, or burn Boulder.

name: Rock vs. Rock Is... a Tie?
description: Turns out rock beats rock.
tips: Kill Boulder with Stone Power.

name: Bomb Beats Rocks
description: Explosions: surprisingly effective against rocks.
tips: Kill Boulder with Bomb Power.

name: What Have You Done??
description: The walls were there for a reason.
tips: Let Boulder eat half of the walls in the maze.

name: It’s Just a “Room” Now
description: Technically, it is still a maze. Technically.
tips: Let Boulder eat all the walls in the maze.

name: My Legs!!!
description: Boulder has discovered the ancient art of foot crushing.
tips: Get crushed by Boulder.

name: Bowling
description: Strike!
tips: Push an ice cube into Boulder.

name: Hard Boots
description: Stone Power: because normal shoes weren't enough.
tips: Dash over spike tiles with Stone Power.

name: Rock Beats Spike
description: Rock beats spike. Nature is healing.
tips: Kill Cacty with Stone Power.

name: 2 Ghosts, 1 Stone
description: Two problems. One rock.
tips: Kill 2 ghosts with a single Stone Power attack.

name: What Was That?
description: You saw nothing. Probably.
tips: Get killed inside Nycto's smoke.

name: This Thing Is Flammable
description: Apparently, smoke has a fire setting.
tips: Get killed by the fire produced by burning Nycto's smoke.

name: Found You
description: Five seconds in the smoke and you still found him.
tips: Eat Nycto after spending 5 seconds in his smoke.

name: They All See You
description: Visibility has left the building.
tips: Cover half of the maze in smoke.

name: I Can’t See Shit
description: Neither can you.
tips: Cover the entire maze in smoke.

name: Extra Sneaky
description: Stealth and smoke. Now that's commitment.
tips: Run into Nycto's smoke while using Stealth Power.

name: Did I Step on Someone?
description: Something definitely made a noise.
tips: Kill a ghost in Nycto's smoke.

name: He’ll Never See This Coming
description: He literally could not see it coming.
tips: Kill Nycto in his smoke while using Stealth Power.

name: Assassinated
description: Quiet, efficient, and extremely rude.
tips: Kill a ghost with Stealth Power.

name: Don’t Do Drugs, Kid
description: Doctor's orders.
tips: Pick up Dr. Mortis's pill.

name: I AM BULLET PROOF!!!
description: The serum has given you entirely too much confidence.
tips: Pick up Serum Power.

name: FDA Approved*
description: The asterisk is doing a lot of work here.
tips: Let Mortis buff another Mortis.

name: Doc, Are You Sure About This?
description: Mortis insists this is perfectly safe.
tips: Let Mortis buff 10 ghosts in the maze.

name: What in the Tarnation
description: The buffed ghost was apparently enough.
tips: Get killed by a buffed special ghost.

name: I Guess That Does Something
description: Speed is technically a buff.
tips: Get killed by the buffed versions of the 4 original ghosts.

name: Refreshing Glass of Water
description: Hydration saves the day.
tips: Cure the Intoxicated debuff by walking into water tiles.

name: We’re So Back
description: The poison wore off. We are so back.
tips: Wait out the Intoxicated debuff.

name: Your Poison Affects Me? Who Decided That?
description: Apparently, the poison respects level transitions more than medicine.
tips: Cure the Intoxicated debuff by proceeding to the next level.

name: You're 100 Years Too Early to Fight Me
description: You brought a buff to a buff fight.
tips: Kill the buffed versions of the 4 original ghosts while having a buff.

name: Finally, a Worthy Opponent
description: Our fight will be legendary
tips: Kill a buffed special ghost while having a buff.

name: Gotta Go Fast
description: Complete a level with ghosts at least 8 units faster than Pac-Man.
tips: Set the ghosts' speed to at least 8 units above Pac-Man's speed, then clear a level.

name: Can't Catch Me
description: Full-clear a board with ghosts at least 8 units faster than Pac-Man.
tips: Set the ghosts' speed to at least 8 units above Pac-Man's speed, then full-clear the board.

name: And They Won't Stop Coming
description: Complete a level with a 5-second-or-less spawn timer and 4 ghosts per wave.
tips: Set the spawn timer to 5 seconds or less and spawn 4 ghosts per wave, then clear a level.

name: Sharpest Tools in the Shed
description: Full-clear a board with a 5-second-or-less spawn timer and 4 ghosts per wave.
tips: Set the spawn timer to 5 seconds or less and spawn 4 ghosts per wave, then full-clear the board.

name: What Even Is the Point
description: Complete a level with both Power time and Pellet time set to 1 second.
tips: Set both Power time and Pellet time to 1 second, then clear a level.

name: Who Needs Power Anyways
description: Full-clear a board with both Power time and Pellet time set to 1 second.
tips: Set both Power time and Pellet time to 1 second, then full-clear the board.

name: The True Maze
description: Clear at least half of a 51×51 maze.
tips: Play a 51×51 maze and clear at least half of it.

name: True Maze Completionist
description: Full-clear a 51×51 maze.
tips: Play a 51×51 maze and full-clear it.

name: Are We There Yet?
description: Spend at least 10 minutes in a 51×51 maze without clearing half of it.
tips: Stay in a 51×51 maze for at least 10 minutes without clearing half of it.

name: This Place Is Crowded
description: Complete the smallest valid maze.
tips: Set the maze to its smallest valid size, then clear a level.

name: Claustrophobia
description: Full-clear the smallest valid maze.
tips: Set the maze to its smallest valid size, then full-clear it.

name: Missing the Point
description: Complete a level without collecting any Power.
tips: Don't collect any Power, then clear a level.

name: Wait, I Was Supposed to Collect Those?
description: Full-clear a board without collecting any Power.
tips: Don't collect any Power, then full-clear the board.

name: Hell Customization
description: Complete a level with an Achievement Point total above 50.
tips: Set your Achievement Points above 50, then clear a level.

name: Overqualified
description: Full-clear a board with an Achievement Point total above 50.
tips: Set your Achievement Points above 50, then full-clear the board.

name: Cosplaying God
description: Complete a level with an Achievement Point total below -100.
tips: Set your Achievement Points below -100, then clear a level.

name: Where's the Fun in That?
description: Full-clear a board with an Achievement Point total below -100.
tips: Set your Achievement Points below -100, then full-clear the board.

name: Good Game!
description: Complete a level with your AP set to 1.
tips: Set your AP to 1, then clear at least half of the board.

name: Absolutely Balanced!
description: Full-clear a board with your AP set to 1.
tips: Set your AP to 1, then full-clear the board.

name: Quality Over Quantity
description: Complete a level with one ghost wave and a 100% special ghost spawn rate.
tips: Set the spawn wave to 1 and the special ghost spawn rate to 100%, then clear a level.

name: Oops, All Specials!
description: Full-clear a board with one ghost wave and a 100% special ghost spawn rate.
tips: Set the spawn wave to 1 and the special ghost spawn rate to 100%, then full-clear the board.

name: Quantity Over Quality
description: Complete a level with 4 ghost waves, a 1-second spawn timer, no special ghosts, and no Power.
tips: Set the spawn wave to 4, the spawn timer to 1 second, and the special ghost chance to 0%, then disable all Power. Clear at least half of the board.

name: NOT Pac-Man Championship Edition
description: Full-clear a board with 4 ghost waves, a 1-second spawn timer, no special ghosts, and no Power.
tips: Set the spawn wave to 4, the spawn timer to 1 second, and the special ghost chance to 0%, then disable all Power. Full-clear the board.

name: That was crazy
description: Half-clear a board with an Achievement Point total above 100.
tips: Set your Achievement Points above 100, then half-clear the board.

name: Now THAT, is crazy
description: Full-clear a board with an Achievement Point total above 100.
tips: Set your Achievement Points above 100, then full-clear the board.

name: You Coward!
description: Half-clear a board with an Achievement Point total below -200.
tips: Set your Achievement Points below -200, then half-clear the board.

name: Spoon-fed Victory
description: Full-clear a board with an Achievement Point total below -200.
tips: Set your Achievement Points below -200, then full-clear the board.
